title: Bhilai
text:
77. Bhilai—Bhilainagar (excluding S.A.F. Colony, Kosa Nala, Supela Bazar West, Supela
Bazar, Supela Bazar East, Supela, Camp West and ex-revenue village Chhaoni lying on
